caption: The drawing shows a single human figure in a full-body profile view, facing to the left. The figure has dark brown skin, curly black hair, and red lips. The person is wearing a yellow hat with a short brim, a red jacket with a light-colored collar over a green vest and a yellow tie, and loose green pants paired with brown shoes. The right hand is bent at the elbow and holds a metallic object, possibly a horseshoe, while the left hand is tucked into the left pocket of the pants. The background is plain and off-white with no other objects or scenery, and there is a small handwritten text in the bottom left corner.
title: Hitching Post
